title: Review json parse unsafe
why: Parsing dynamic JSON can throw on malformed text, and successful parsing alone does not validate the resulting value's shape.
suggestion: Handle malformed input at the appropriate boundary and validate dynamic values before use; keep intentional exception propagation or trusted-producer contracts explicit.
limitations: Direct round trips and variables assigned from JSON.stringify before parsing are excluded, as are recognized lexical try/catch blocks and tooling paths.

This is local lexical advice, not proof of an unsafe boundary. Validation after parsing, callers that handle parser errors, native or subprocess producers and schema contracts are not resolved. A type annotation or successful HTTP status does not establish JSON syntax or result shape.
